name: Keeper Bel'varil
summary: At Tarren Mill, Keeper Bel'varil studies magic and alchemy for the Forsaken. With Wordeen Voidglare, he searches Hillsbrad Foothills for relics and binding materials.

sections.title: Study in Tarren Mill
sections.body: Tarren Mill is besieged, and Keeper Bel'varil supports the Forsaken there with magic and alchemy. The royal apothecaries and soldiers focus on the Alliance garrison at Southshore, down the road. So Bel'varil turns to practical sorcery, sending travelers to recover stone tokens and binding bracers from nearby elemental and enchanted threats.

faq.answer: Keeper Bel'varil studies magic in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. With fellow researcher Wordeen Voidglare, he examines magical artifacts and reagents found across the contested territory.

faq.q: Where can I find Keeper Bel'varil?
faq.answer: Keeper Bel'varil is in Tarren Mill, the Forsaken settlement in northern Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: What tasks does Keeper Bel'varil offer?
faq.answer: Keeper Bel'varil sends Horde adventurers to collect magical remnants, including stone tokens and bracers of binding. He studies them to understand and manipulate elemental forces.

angles.text: As a Horde champion in Hillsbrad Foothills, you can help Bel'varil subdue elemental threats and recover binding charms. He offers practical rewards for this work.
As Forsaken, you share Bel'varil's pursuit of arcane mastery and resourcefulness. His careful study of regional relics seeks an edge for your people in Lordaeron.
